A table of every documented function. Click a name to open its full
documentation page.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load cfbstats from the checkout when the package is not installed, so the
# site build does not require a package install (decision 0030).
if (requireNamespace("cfbstats", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # vignettes render in a fresh quarto R session: attach the installed package
  # (CI installs it via local::.) or source the checkout fallback below.
  library(cfbstats)
} else {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  for (src in sort(list.files(file.path(dir, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE))) {
    source(src, local = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  }
}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)

root <- cfbstats_root()
rd_files <- sort(list.files(file.path(root, "man"), pattern = "\\.Rd$", full.names = TRUE))

# Title from the \title{} section; internal functions (altdoc skips them) omitted.
fn_meta <- map_dfr(rd_files, function(f) {
  raw <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  if (any(grepl("\\\\internal", raw))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  title <- tryCatch(
    paste(unlist(tools:::.Rd_get_metadata(raw, "title")), collapse = " "),
    error = function(e) name
  )
  tibble(
    fn = name,
    title = ifelse(nzchar(title), title, name),
    link = paste0("../man/", name, ".html")
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: table
#| echo: false
reactable(
  fn_meta,
  columns = list(
    fn = colDef(
      name = "Function",
      cell = function(value, index) {
        tags$a(href = fn_meta$link[index], value, class = "fs-5")
      }
    ),
    title = colDef(name = "Title"),
    link = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  searchable = TRUE,
  paginationType = "jump",
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 25, 50),
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  theme = reactable::reactableTheme(cellPadding = "10px 10px")
)
```
